notes.title: Super Update
notes.notes:
[b][i][h3]No Way Out: The Rebirth.[/h3][/i][/b]
During this event, you'll have the opportunity to experience all the new features firsthand and suggest new mechanics directly to the developer. Your input is crucial for the game's future, so be sure to share your feedback!

And don't worry! You can always play the classic version by selecting 'Legacy' in the Betas tab under the game's settings.

notes.title: No Way Out now has an Open World Map!
notes.notes:
After a survey, players decided for a Open World format. And the map was already made available in the last update.
Improvements will be made soon!
Thank you for your participation!

notes.title: No Way Out Update 1
notes.notes:
[b]This update brings:[/b]
- Support for 4K Resolution
- End of the Open World model
- Implantation of the episode division model into parts composed of puzzles.
- Traps, intruder detection lights and toxicity will make the levels more challenging and interesting.
- Menu fonts changed for easy reading.

In the next update the menu and levels will be more polished.

If you want new features or changes contact the developer by Community Hub.

Thanks for Playing No Way Out!

notes.title: No Way Out Released!
notes.notes:
It is already possible to play the first episode of the game and still check the basis of the first part of the second.
Be sure to send your feedback to the developer. Suggestions are welcome. Help create this game!
Remember that this game is always evolving and you are the one that dictates the best way forward! Thank you!
